topic: Describe a place you would like to visit in the future
prompts: Why would you like to visit it?
sample_answer: I have always wanted to visit Kyoto in Japan. Kyoto is famous for its ancient temples, traditional gardens, and beautiful cherry blossoms in spring. I would travel there with my family, and we would spend at least a week exploring the city. I would love to visit Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, and Fushimi Inari with its thousands of red torii gates. We would also enjoy traditional Japanese tea ceremonies and Kaiseki cuisine. Kyoto represents a perfect blend of history and natural beauty, which is why it has been at the top of my travel list for many years.

topic: Do you prefer traveling alone or with others?
prompts: Why do you have this preference?
Where do you like to go?
sample_answer: I prefer traveling with friends or family because sharing experiences makes them more memorable. When I travel alone, I enjoy the freedom to plan my own schedule, but I miss having someone to discuss what I see. I usually travel during holidays, and I love exploring historical cities and natural landscapes.

topic: Describe a book that has influenced you
prompts: What is the title and who wrote it?
How did it influence your thinking?
sample_answer: One book that influenced me deeply is 'Sapiens' by Yuval Noah Harari. The book explores the history of humankind from biological evolution to modern society. It made me rethink how human cooperation through shared myths has shaped our world. After reading it, I looked at culture, religion, and economics from a completely new perspective. It encouraged me to question assumptions and appreciate how complex human societies truly are.

topic: How do you usually spend your weekends?
prompts: What do you like to do?
Who do you spend time with?
Why do you enjoy these activities?
sample_answer: On weekends, I try to balance rest and activity. On Saturday mornings, I often exercise or go for a walk in a park. In the afternoon, I might meet friends for coffee or visit a museum. Sundays are more relaxed - I read books, watch films, or cook with my family. I think weekends are important for recharging energy and spending quality time with loved ones.

topic: Describe a teacher who influenced your education
sample_answer: My high school English teacher, Ms. Chen, had a huge influence on me. She taught literature and writing with great passion. What made her special was how she encouraged every student to express their own opinions rather than simply memorize answers. Because of her, I developed a genuine love for reading and writing. She also taught me to think critically and to respect different perspectives. I still remember many of her lessons today.

topic: What are the advantages and disadvantages of online learning?
prompts: Do you think classrooms will disappear?
What skills are most important for students today?
sample_answer: Online learning offers convenience and flexibility - students can study anywhere at their own pace. It also provides access to courses from top universities that were previously unavailable. However, online learning lacks face-to-face interaction, which is crucial for developing communication skills and motivation. Some students also struggle with self-discipline when learning remotely. I believe classrooms will continue to exist, but they will increasingly blend with digital tools to create hybrid learning experiences.

topic: Describe an important decision you made
prompts: How did it affect your life?
sample_answer: One of the most important decisions I made was to study abroad for my master's degree. It was difficult because it meant leaving my family, friends, and familiar environment behind. However, the experience transformed my life. I learned to be independent, met people from many different cultures, and gained a global perspective. Studying abroad also improved my English dramatically and opened up career opportunities I would not have had otherwise. Looking back, it was challenging but absolutely the right decision.

topic: Do you think children should be taught a second language from an early age?
prompts: What are the benefits of learning languages early?
sample_answer: I strongly believe children should start learning a second language from an early age. Young children have a natural ability to pick up pronunciation and grammar that declines as they get older. Learning another language also helps children understand and appreciate different cultures. Some people worry it might confuse children, but research actually shows bilingual children develop better problem-solving skills and cognitive flexibility. In our increasingly connected world, speaking multiple languages is an enormous advantage.

topic: Describe a memorable event from your childhood
prompts: Why do you still remember it?
sample_answer: One memorable event was a school trip to a national park when I was about ten years old. My class spent three days hiking, camping, and learning about local wildlife. I still remember it because it was the first time I had stayed away from home without my parents. We learned how to set up tents, start a campfire safely, and identify different birds and plants. Our guide told fascinating stories about the park's ecosystem. That trip sparked my lifelong interest in nature and environmental protection.

topic: How has technology changed the way we communicate?
prompts: Is communication better or worse now?
How will communication change in the future?
sample_answer: Technology has dramatically changed communication. We can now instantly message people anywhere in the world through apps like WeChat or WhatsApp. Video calls let us see family members who live far away. However, this convenience has a downside - many people now prefer texting to talking in person, which can weaken real relationships. Face-to-face communication remains important because it conveys emotion through body language and facial expressions that digital messages cannot capture. In the future, I expect virtual reality to make long-distance communication feel more natural.

topic: What do you do to stay healthy?
sample_answer: I try to maintain a healthy lifestyle through regular exercise and balanced eating. I jog three times a week and practice yoga on weekends. For my diet, I eat plenty of vegetables and fruits while limiting fast food and sugary drinks. I also make sure to drink enough water throughout the day. To manage stress, I enjoy reading before bed and practicing meditation. Getting seven to eight hours of sleep is also essential for my health and energy levels.

My favorite hobby is photography. I started taking photos about five years ago after I received a camera as a birthday gift from my parents. At first, I only took pictures of my family and travels, but gradually I became more serious about it. I love photography because it teaches me to notice beautiful moments and details that most people overlook. Whether it's the light at sunset, street scenes, or people's expressions, photography helps me appreciate the world more deeply. I often spend weekends exploring new places with my camera.

topic: How do you think work will change in the future?
prompts: Will people work more or less?
sample_answer: I believe work will change significantly in the future due to automation and artificial intelligence. Many routine jobs will disappear, while new careers requiring creativity, emotional intelligence, and technical skills will emerge. Remote work will likely become more common, giving employees greater flexibility but also blurring boundaries between work and personal life. Industries related to healthcare, renewable energy, and technology will probably grow. Job security may become less important than employability - the ability to continuously learn and adapt will be essential for success.

I really admire my grandmother. She raised five children while working as a nurse and maintaining a positive attitude throughout her life. What I admire most is her resilience - she faced many difficulties but never complained. She also has remarkable kindness and generosity; she always helps neighbors and friends without expecting anything in return. Even in her eighties, she continues to learn new things and maintains an active lifestyle. Her life teaches me that strength of character matters more than any achievement.

topic: What role does music play in your life?
prompts: What kind of music do you like?
When do you listen to music?
Have you learned any musical instrument?
sample_answer: Music plays an important role in my life. I enjoy many different genres, from classical to pop and jazz. I usually listen to music when I'm working out, commuting, or relaxing at home. Classical music helps me focus when I'm studying, while upbeat pop music energizes me for exercise. I learned basic piano as a child, though I am not very skilled. Music helps me manage my mood and provides a wonderful escape from daily stress.
